title: Subject-Verb Agreement
front: What is the core rule of Subject-Verb Agreement?
back: A singular subject takes a singular verb (e.g., 'He speaks Spanish'), while a plural subject takes a plural verb (e.g., 'They speak Spanish'). Be careful with collective nouns (e.g. 'The family is') and indefinite pronouns.

title: Active vs. Passive Voice
front: When is it appropriate to use passive voice in writing?
back: Passive voice is used when the focus is on the action or the object receiving the action, rather than who is performing it. Example: 'The research was completed' vs 'We completed the research'.
